description: This file defines a class 'Overview' that models an email overview object, likely used in handling email data within the SuiteCRM module related to inbound emails. The class mirrors the structure of data returned from imap_fetch_overview() and includes properties related to email attributes such as subject, sender, date, message ID, and flags. It also initializes metadata for email cache from external metadata files.

classes.name: Overview
classes.description: A class that models the overview information of an email, with properties reflecting email attributes and a constructor that loads email cache metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Overview object, loading email cache metadata from external files and setting internal field definitions and indices.
